_comment_logging: EF logs every SQL statement at Information; the job worker polls on a timer, so that alone produced ~150 lines/minute and buried real errors in `docker logs`. NOTE: every key inside LogLevel must be a valid log level — a comment there crashes startup.

Harbora._comment: MasterKey MUST be supplied via the HARBORA_MASTER_KEY env var in production (the installer generates it in deploy/.env). Left blank here so the app fails closed if it is missing.
Harbora._comment_proxy: TrustedProxyNetworks: comma-separated CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For headers are believed (the reverse proxy in front of the panel). Blank = Docker's private ranges. Widen this only to networks you control — it decides which IP the rate limiter and audit log record.

Jobs._comment_concurrency: MaxConcurrency: how many background jobs — deployments, backups, managed-service provisions, cron runs — this panel runs at the same time. Two jobs for the same target never overlap whatever this says. Leave it out to get 4, or the core count where that is smaller: a job here is usually a docker build on this same host. Set it to 1 to restore the one-job-at-a-time worker the platform ran before, which needs only a restart.

Runtime._comment_retention: ImageRetentionCount: how many past versions keep their build image after a deploy. This is the real depth of instant rollback — beyond it a rollback must redeploy from source. 0 disables pruning (images accumulate forever).

Backups._comment_safety: EncryptArchives: encrypt artifacts (AES-GCM, key derived from the master key) before they leave staging — volume/database archives hold raw application data. SnapshotBeforeRestore: tar the current volume aside before a restore overwrites it, so a bad restore is itself recoverable.
Backups._comment_module: Backup module (docs/backup-sync/). Kopia drives a local repository only; S3-family repositories use the built-in engine, whose credentials stay encrypted end to end. RestoreRoot is the directory every restore destination must resolve inside.
Backups._comment_sources: AllowedSourceRoots is EMPTY on purpose: until it names directories, no directory can be backed up. A backup engine pointed at an arbitrary path is an arbitrary-file read with a download button on the end, so the default must not include /etc or Harbora's own key directory. Docker volumes need no allowlist — they are already this platform's own workloads — but they are copied into StagingDirectory by a helper first, which costs a temporary full copy on disk.

_comment_sync: Syncthing's own API is a direct path to every file it holds, bypassing Harbora's authentication — bind it to loopback or a private network only, never publish it. ApiKey belongs in an environment variable, not here. AllowedRoots is EMPTY on purpose: a sync folder is a directory this node both reads AND writes on a remote device's instruction, which is a stronger capability than backup's read.
_comment_features: Backup and Sync ship OFF. Enabling is a deliberate act after reading docs/backup-sync/MERGE_GUIDE.md — in particular, the Kopia CLI flags are written against a pinned release and should be exercised once against the installed binary first. EncryptedSyncNode is experimental.
